title: AskQuestionResponse
description: 200 response of the ask routes (HEL-1745). Never carries a model id, token count or cost. Neither the question nor the answer is stored.

answer.description: At most 6 sentences and 1200 characters; every number and date is traced to a citation in its sentence.

citations.description: Exactly the citations the answer uses, in order of first use.

id.description: The marker id used in the answer, e.g. c3.

pin.description: Null unless every cited Output is on one pipeline the caller can edit and 1..8 non-insight Outputs were cited. Creating it does not render.

request.description: A POST /api/pipelines/:pipelineId/outputs body: kind insight, config.prompt = the question, config.reads.outputs = the cited non-insight Output ids, config.refresh = manual. Holds no answer text.
